expected_findings.description: An empty `OutputSchema` produces a grammatically broken string with trailing `": ."`; while unreachable in production, the function should have a comment or assertion.
The `int`, `bool`, and `object` branches of the `completion_instruction` function are untested; the test helper `_schema()` only uses `enum` and `string`.
Optional marker placement for optional enum fields produces back-to-back parenthetical groups `(a|b) (optional)`, which is awkward though not a functional bug.
